parameter.expression: SELECT CODEMP AS VALUE ,CODEMP || ' - ' ||NOMEFANTASIA AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP WHERE CODEMP IN (1,2)

grid.expression: SELECT G.CODEMP AS CODEMP ,G.DTREF AS DTREF ,OPTION_LABEL('TGFOIR','TIPAPURACAO',G.TIPAPURACAO) AS TIPO ,G.CODREC AS CODREC ,UFS.DESCRICAO AS DESCRICAO ,G.DTVCTO AS DTVCTO ,G.CODUF AS CODUF ,G.VALOR AS VALOR ,(SELECT GUI.DESCRGUIA FROM AD_TGSFINDET D INNER JOIN AD_TGSFINGUI GUI ON GUI.ID = D.ID WHERE D.CODREC = G.CODREC) AS DESCRICAO_GUIA FROM TGFOIR G INNER JOIN TSIUFS UFS ON UFS.CODUF = G.CODUF WHERE G.DTREF >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND G.DTREF <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND G.CODEMP IN :P_CODEMP UNION ALL SELECT CAB.CODEMP AS CODEMP ,TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI, 'MM') AS DTREF ,'Retenção Federal' AS TIPO ,IMC.CODREC AS CODREC ,'MG' AS DESCRICAO ,ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI, 'MM'), 1) + 19 AS DTVCTO ,49 AS CODUF ,SUM(IMN.VALOR) AS VALOR ,(SELECT GUI.DESCRGUIA FROM AD_TGSFINDET D INNER JOIN AD_TGSFINGUI GUI ON GUI.ID = D.ID WHERE D.CODREC = IMC.CODREC) AS DESCRICAO_GUIA FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFIMN IMN ON IMN.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFIMC IMC ON IMC.CODIMP = IMN.CODIMP WHERE CAB.DTENTSAI >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTENTSAI <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_CODEMP GROUP BY CAB.CODEMP, TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI, 'MM'), IMC.CODREC ORDER BY CODEMP,DTREF
